artist.title: Shaky
artist.description: A bold, danceable vibe that pushes Marathi music into exciting new territory.

artist.title: Asal Kolaar
artist.description: The track flexes confidence, hustle, and street pride—served with Asal Kolaar’s raw Tamil slang, punchy delivery, and a beat that hits hard from the first bar.

artist.title: Adayein Teri
artist.description: Adayein Teri set to a shimmering disco rhythm, this hypnotic track weaves a poetic tale of desire, mystery, and unspoken emotion.

artist.title: Not Guilty
artist.description: The track reflects real-life struggles, false blame, loyalty, and inner strength. With powerful Haryanvi lyrics.
